original: WPRPLACE is one of eight national parks in Ireland, managed by the National Parks and Wildlife Service. It is located in the northwest of Connemara in County Galway, on the west coast.
translated: WPRPLACE ist einer von acht Nationalparks in Irland, die vom National Parks and Wildlife Service verwaltet werden. Es liegt im Nordwesten von Connemara in der Grafschaft Galway, an der Westküste.
